answer: Each identity binds one verified volunteer record from the Sparrow Trust: 120 hours over 90 days at a timber-frame shelter build, charity-signed, plus a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. The bond doubles per extra record from one funding cluster (25, 50, 100), so the first 10 fakes lock 25,575 POA and need 1,200 supervised hours; 100 fakes need 12,000 hours. Each epoch the charity re-attests the thread of attendance logs within 72 hours; two missed re-attestations forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts for 3 epochs. One household volunteering together passes a joint in-person check.
